A geniculum is a knee-like bend. It is a pulvinus-like joint only on a petiole. On culms, nodes and palm parts it is a different structure.

A bent or swollen joint of the petiole is the petiole pulvinus.
A tubular sheath is a leaf sheath or a sheathing base. A scale leaf (cataphyll) is a different organ.

A sterile sheath is a sheath around a sterile part, as in ferns or Cyperaceae. It is not a scale leaf. Use leaf sheath only when it is clearly a leaf sheath.
